617:t_139:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「It is upon the sacrifice of countless lives that you stand now.」

617:t_139:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I don't deny it...! To repay those sacrifices, I will not stop walking!」

617:t_139:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then what you and I carry...! Which of them weighs more, we will decide in this battle!」

617:t_139:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「There is no higher or lower among feelings!」

617:t_139:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But, $$ヴィルダーク$$! You are one who blocks the future... which makes you my enemy!!」

617:t_140:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_140:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You fight without any meaning?」

617:t_140:3.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I don't owe you an answer.」

617:t_140:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...A foolish question, it seems. I sense firm will in you.」

617:t_140:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But, $$異能生存体$$! I seek what lies beyond that causality!!」

617:t_140:6.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I have no intention of keeping you company.」

617:t_141:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_141:1.en:
$$桂$$
「To go home to the one I love! That's why!」

617:t_141:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Are you aware of your own mission?」

617:t_141:3.en:
$$桂$$
「If you mean the power of the $$特異点$$, you don't need to tell me!」

617:t_141:4.en:
$$桂$$
「But what lies beyond that is meeting $$ミムジィ$$ again in a peaceful world!」

617:t_141:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The world and a single woman...! The resolve to seek both!」

617:t_141:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will end your role! That is my true mission!」

617:t_142:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_142:1.en:
$n
「For the world, for peace, for the future, for freedom, for justice, for everyone...」

617:t_142:3.en:
$n
「Who's the one joking here! How many lives do you think were lost because of you and the Empire!」

617:t_142:4.en:
$n
「Is there anything that could make up for that!? However much we wish, it isn't enough!」

617:t_142:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...I apologize for underestimating you.」

617:t_142:6.en:
$n
「Who needs that!? If you're sorry, then get off Earth!!」

617:t_142:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That comes after I defeat you all!」

617:t_142:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come, $$いがみ合う双子$$! Offer that power to me!!」

617:t_143:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_143:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「You won't understand anyway, but I'll tell you!」

617:t_143:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「For the sake of good beer!」

617:t_143:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「How would a guy who sits lording it over everyone at the top of that stupidly huge building know how good beer tastes after a hard day's sweat!」

617:t_143:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「And all of that only exists because of peace! Vanish from this planet, $$ヴィルダーク$$!!」

617:t_143:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「When the time comes, I will do so sooner or later...!」

617:t_143:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「And to that end too, $$傷だらけの獅子$$! Offer up your power to me!」

617:t_144:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_144:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「So that is your strength... the $$スフィア$$ of the $$悲しみの乙女$$.」

617:t_144:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Why did you do that to $$バルビエル$$...?」

617:t_144:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「An enemy, and a despicable man at that... You sympathize with him?」

617:t_144:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That's not it. But I cannot forgive what you have done.」

617:t_144:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「People like you spread sorrow without end... I fight to stop that!」

617:t_144:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well, $$悲しみの乙女$$! That resolve gives you strength!」

617:t_144:9.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will overcome it! And make that $$スフィア$$ my own!」

617:t_145:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_145:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「At the very least, I'm not about to do as I'm told by someone who tries to push other people around by force like that.」

617:t_145:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「So that is your unbreakable will, $$揺れる天秤$$!」

617:t_145:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then I will shatter it and make you tell me your answer!」

617:t_145:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Even I have a sense of shame!」

617:t_145:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Let's go, $$ヴィルダーク$$! For freedom, peace, and personal reasons, I'm taking you down here!!」

617:t_146:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_146:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'll pass on that sort of thing. AG, it's up to you.」

617:t_146:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To blast an obnoxious guy like you away and protect the peace and freedom of this world!」

617:t_146:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well. But the power of that ship is to be offered to me!」

617:t_146:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I cannot let a second $$黒い太陽#sol$$ go unchallenged!!」

622:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...$$エルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス$$, $$尸空#pilot$$, $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$...」

622:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I never imagined the showdown with them would end in a way like that.」

622:t_10:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's not that. ...It's just that it looked like $$エルーナルーナ$$ handed her $$スフィア$$ over to $$ヴィルダーク$$ of her own will.」

622:t_10:9.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Only $$バルビエル$$ seemed different, though...」

622:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Because each of you fought your respective rival, $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z were created. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

622:t_10:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$Ｚチップ$$ born of a fight between Reactors, huh... Heh, even that gloomy man couldn't commit fully to nihilism.」

622:t_10:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「That woman did whatever she wanted to the very end.」

622:t_10:13.en:
$$セツコ$$
「In the end, he remained swallowed by hatred...」

622:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Each Reactor lived their own life. Their paths will be engraved in the $$Ｚクリスタル$$.」

622:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「(I believe that someday it will surely help us...)」

622:t_10:21.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Were you thinking about $$ガドライト#pilot$$?」

622:t_10:22.en:
$n
「...It's not that I'm sad he died or anything like that...」

622:t_10:23.en:
$n
「I keep worrying about his daughters, who lost both their parents...」

622:t_10:24.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$アンナ$$ and $$ロッタ$$... So they were given their mother's name...」
